# Practice as algorithm

> Every practice of the AI-augmented method read as an algorithm for a named problem: one page per practice with the problem class, the best-known algorithm and its reference implementation, the gap and the change proposed, in a table a program checks. First pass written: twelve rows, 40 sources, a baseline.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [The map](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/map/README.md): twelve practices, each with its problem class, best-known algorithm, reference implementation, gap and proposed change
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/evidence/README.md): the frame, the protocol and the bibliography of 40 sources
- [Practice as algorithm](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/README.md): the scope, the findings of the first pass, the baseline and the table of rows
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-practice/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
